description: This Java interface defines a ConnectivityCommandInterceptor used to process connectivity-related commands within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides methods to intercept commands, possibly throw exceptions for invalid commands, and retrieve connections associated with commands.

classes.name: ConnectivityCommandInterceptor
classes.description: An interface for intercepting and validating connectivity commands, potentially throwing exceptions if commands are invalid. It extends functional interfaces for consuming commands.

methods.name: getConnectionFromCommand
methods.description: Retrieves the Connection object associated with a given ConnectivityCommand, based on its type.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Default method implementation that resolves the connection from the command using getConnectionFromCommand and passes it along with the command to another accept method.
